summary: Practise credit data preparation, PD, LGD, EAD analysis and model validation in Python and R. Explore the 10-day course and its outputs.
lede: Credit risk analytics uses borrower, facility and portfolio data to estimate risk and assess model performance. For credit-risk analysts, model developers and portfolio-risk practitioners, the course uses Python and R to prepare and reconcile data, estimate PD, LGD and EAD, and analyse portfolio segments. Participants also practise discrimination and calibration testing, back-testing, monitoring and reproducible reporting to support model review and credit-risk decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare credit data, develop or validate risk models, or report portfolio movements and model performance. It suits intermediate practitioners who can work with Python and R and want to make estimates, tests and findings more reproducible.
modules: Credit Risk Reporting and Action Plans
prerequisites: Intermediate level. You should have working familiarity with credit-risk analysis and basic Python and R; coding is required for the hands-on analysis exercises. Access to Python and R on a laptop is needed. Suitable credit data availability should be confirmed before delivery.
